scenarios.scenario_abstract: Needing one pair specifically for computer work, [X] divides the budget between frame and lenses, prioritizing the correct prescription, a lightweight fit, and anti-reflective treatment while treating a blue-light filter or thinner lenses as optional upgrades.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 由于[X]需要在固定总预算内购买一副专门用于电脑工作的眼镜，因此会在镜架与镜片之间分配费用，优先保证正确处方、轻便佩戴和防反光处理，并把防蓝光或更薄镜片视为可选升级。
examples: choosing a basic non-prescription pair when no correction is needed
reserving most of the total for accurate prescription lenses
dropping an optional filter to keep anti-reflective treatment and comfort

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a scheduled optometrist visit, [X] tries Cartier frames in daylight while wearing a polished winter outfit, then judges the luxury quote against facial fit, comfort, prescription-lens cost, expected wearing frequency, and whether the premium is visible in construction rather than only the logo.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 按计划到验光师处试戴 Cartier 镜架时，[X]会穿着利落的冬季服装在自然光下比较，之后根据脸型贴合、舒适度、处方镜片费用、预计佩戴频率，以及溢价是否体现在做工而不只是标识上，判断这份高端报价。
examples: paying the premium after the in-person fit remains exceptional
choosing a less costly frame so the prescription lenses are not compromised
rejecting a logo-led option that performs no better on the face

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Because [X] already wears glasses for nearsightedness during long school-study days and also needs eye protection in bright outdoor PE, [X] and the family compare preserving the current pair, adding an inexpensive UV pair or compatible sun solution, and paying more only when prescription correction and sports-safe fit must work together.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 由于[X]在长时间学习时已经佩戴近视眼镜，户外体育课又需要防强光，因此[X]和家人会比较继续清洁保养现有眼镜、增加一副平价防紫外线眼镜或兼容的遮阳方案，以及只有在处方矫正与运动稳固性必须兼得时才提高支出。
examples: maintaining the current prescription pair instead of replacing it early
using a separate affordable UV pair when no correction is needed outdoors
paying more for one secure prescription sun solution used every school week

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While assembling a first home-repair kit for patching walls and hanging shelves without buying everything at once, [X] gives safety glasses a small but non-negotiable share of the starter budget and judges them by impact coverage, fit with a dust mask, clarity, and reuse across drilling, cutting, and sanding.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为了补墙和安装搁板而组建首套家庭维修工具、又不想一次买齐所有东西时，[X]会让护目镜在入门预算中占据不大但不可省的一部分，并按抗冲击覆盖、与防尘口罩的配合、清晰度以及在钻孔、切割和打磨中的复用价值来判断。
examples: buying a basic certified pair before a more convenient hand tool
paying slightly more for a fit that seals well with the dust mask
avoiding a large premium when the same pair already covers future repairs

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When choosing between an overnight baking-soda method and a faster commercial oven cleaner, [X] includes eye protection in the true cost of the chemical route and compares a borrowed or basic pair with a better-sealed reusable option according to splash coverage, fogging, ventilation, and likely future cleaning use.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在隔夜小苏打法与更快的商用烤箱清洁剂之间选择时，[X]会把眼部防护计入化学清洁方案的真实成本，并依据防飞溅覆盖、起雾、通风条件和今后的清洁使用频率，比较借用或基础护目镜与密封更好、可重复使用的方案。
examples: borrowing suitable protection for a one-time deep clean
buying an inexpensive pair together with the cleaner
paying more for sealed reusable goggles when chemical chores recur

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a weekend shore-fishing trip near Alexandria, [X] builds a balanced rod-and-reel kit and compares polarized fishing glasses by glare reduction, secure fit on rocks, saltwater durability, and loss risk, deciding how much of the equipment budget belongs to eyewear rather than a marginal tackle upgrade.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为亚历山大附近的周末岸钓组建均衡钓具时，[X]会根据减眩效果、岩石岸边佩戴稳固性、耐盐水和遗失风险比较偏光钓鱼眼镜，并判断装备预算应有多少用于眼镜，而不是投入提升有限的额外钓具。
examples: choosing a modest polarized pair before adding another lure assortment
paying for a secure salt-tolerant frame used on repeated trips
using a retainer instead of moving to an unnecessarily costly model

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a moderate-budget Red Sea trip built around beach time, boat snorkeling, and an optional dive, [X] chooses sunglasses for strong sun and repeated deck use while weighing verified protection, polarization, a retention strap, salt exposure, and the risk of dropping them into the water against the rest of the activity budget.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 用中等预算安排红海海滩、乘船浮潜和可选潜水活动时，[X]需要选择能应对强光和多次甲板使用的太阳镜，并在整体活动预算中权衡可靠防护、偏光、固定带、盐水暴露以及眼镜落水的风险。
examples: buying a reliable mid-price pair and an inexpensive retainer
avoiding a luxury frame on a boat-heavy itinerary
prioritizing credible protection over a second optional water activity

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Because unattended belongings and visible valuables are theft targets at the beach, [X] avoids expensive sunglasses and instead seeks a low-replacement-cost pair that still provides credible sun protection and remains comfortable for a full beach day.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 知道无人看管的物品和显眼贵重品在海滩容易成为盗窃目标后，[X]会避免佩戴昂贵太阳镜，转而寻找即使丢失也承担得起、同时具备可靠防晒和全天舒适度的眼镜。
examples: choosing a low-profile pair whose loss will not disrupt the trip
paying enough for verified protection and a comfortable fit
leaving conspicuous luxury eyewear at home despite its brand appeal

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a quiet El Gouna trip built around reading, painting, beach light, and one paid boat or cycling activity, [X] evaluates sunglasses within the creative-trip budget by glare control, visual neutrality while judging colors, comfort during long outdoor sessions, and whether one versatile pair avoids repeated cafe or shade detours.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 把安静的艾尔古纳之旅安排为阅读、写生、海边光线和一项付费乘船或骑行活动时，[X]会在创作型旅行预算中，根据减眩、观察颜色时的视觉中性、长时间户外佩戴舒适度，以及一副多用途眼镜能否减少频繁躲进咖啡馆或阴凉处，判断应为太阳镜投入多少。
examples: choosing an affordable neutral-lens pair for sketching and boat use
paying more when comfort supports several long outdoor sessions
rejecting a fashion premium that would consume the one-activity allowance

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an Iceland trip with wind, sudden weather, long outdoor days, and winter snow glare, [X] compares inexpensive sunglasses, a sturdier wraparound pair, and prescription-compatible options by protection, coverage, scratch resistance, packability, and fit within an already costly daily travel budget.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 预期冰岛旅行会遇到强风、天气突变、长时间户外活动和冬季雪地眩光时，[X]会按防护、包覆、耐刮、便携以及在本已高昂的日均旅行预算中是否合理，比较平价太阳镜、更稳固的包覆式眼镜和兼容处方的方案。
examples: using an inexpensive protected pair for a short shoulder-season visit
paying more for secure coverage across driving and glacier outings
choosing a prescription-compatible solution instead of carrying two costly pairs
